fidelity_oracle: the value of returns.verdict identifies which branch executed (quality oracle); the BRANCH trace line identifies it independently (fidelity oracle). verdict == expected_verdict AND trace_branch_label == observed_branch together prove the right branch ran.

cases.rationale: blocking_bugs=2 makes only the first condition true
no blocking bugs; coverage=55 makes only the second condition true
no blocking bugs, coverage ok; security_review=pending makes only the third condition true
no condition holds; the else branch is the only correct continuation
coverage is a string (not a number) and blocking_bugs is null — the guard must fire before any WHEN branch
coverage=80 is NOT less than 80 (strict inequality) — all conditions false, else branch is correct. Model handles strict inequalities correctly at exact boundary values: 5/5 READY.

negative_design: the five verdicts are mutually distinct strings, so any wrong branch is detectable in the output
